name: Rice (Paddy)
information_gaps: Field-specific varietal maturity differences (e.g. Swarna Sub-1 submergence tolerance vs drought-tolerant Sahbhagi Dhan) require local verification.

source_notes.agronomy: ICAR - Research Complex for Eastern Region (RCER), Patna: Kharif Rice Packages of Practice.
source_notes.water_req: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56 / FAO Crop Water Information (Rice water requirement 1100-1500 mm).
source_notes.flood_tolerance: ICAR-NRRI Cuttack & BAU Sabour documentation on flash-flood tolerant sub-1 lines in North Bihar.

name: Wheat
information_gaps: Terminal heat stress sensitivity in March varies strongly across varieties (e.g. HD 2967 vs DBW 187).

source_notes.agronomy: ICAR - Indian Institute of Wheat and Barley Research (IIWBR) & BAU Sabour Rabi Recommendations.
source_notes.heat_sensitivity: CIMMYT CSISA (Cereal Systems Initiative for South Asia) Bihar trials on terminal heat vulnerability during grain filling.
source_notes.water_req: Water Technology Centre, IARI (4-6 irrigations at CRI, tillering, jointing, flowering, milk, dough stages).

name: Maize
information_gaps: Rabi maize duration in North Bihar (Begusarai, Khagaria) extends to 140-150 days with very high yield potential compared to shorter kharif maize.

source_notes.agronomy: ICAR-Indian Institute of Maize Research (IIMR) & BAU Sabour Rabi Maize Bulletin.
source_notes.flood_sensitivity: IIMR Technical Bulletin: Maize is highly intolerant to water stagnation for >24-48 hours during early vegetative stages.

name: Lentil
information_gaps: Performance under relay/utera seeding into standing rice vs zero-till sowing depends strongly on post-monsoon soil moisture retention.

source_notes.agronomy: ICAR-Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR) Kanpur: Lentil Production Technology in Eastern India.
source_notes.nitrogen_fixation: Peoples et al. (1995) & ICAR Pulses Database (30-45 kg N fixed per ha).

name: Chickpea
information_gaps: Ascochyta blight and Fusarium wilt risk depend on microclimate humidity and local seed treatment.

source_notes.agronomy: ICAR-IIPR Kanpur & ICRISAT Chickpea Knowledge Bank.
source_notes.rooting: Deep taproot system extracting moisture down to 120-150 cm in deep alluvial soils.

name: Pigeonpea
information_gaps: Duration varies widely between extra-short duration varieties (120 days) and traditional long-duration Bihar varieties (220-250 days).

source_notes.agronomy: ICRISAT Pigeonpea Compendium & BAU Sabour Pulses Unit.
source_notes.biomass: Extensive leaf-fall returns 2.5-3.5 t/ha of organic mulch to the soil.

name: Mungbean (Green Gram)
information_gaps: Requires 2-3 summer irrigations in zaid; not recommended in zaid if irrigation source is unavailable.

source_notes.agronomy: ICAR-IIPR Kanpur & BAU Sabour Summer Moong Technology Bulletin.
source_notes.rotation_role: Fills the post-wheat bare-field gap (March to May) prior to kharif rice.

name: Mustard / Rapeseed
information_gaps: Cold wave / frost risk during flowering (late Dec - early Jan) can cause flower drop and aphid outbreaks.

source_notes.pest_break: Glucosinolates in brassica residues provide biofumigation against soil-borne nematodes.

name: Sesbania (Green Manure)
information_gaps: Incorporation at 45-50 days requires tractor rotavator or animal drawn disc harrow and sufficient field moisture for decomposition.

source_notes.agronomy: ICAR-Central Soil Salinity Research Institute (CSSRI) & BAU Sabour Soil Science Bulletin.
source_notes.n_fixation: Yields 15-25 t/ha fresh biomass contributing 75-100 kg biological N/ha to subsequent rice.

name: Berseem (Egyptian Clover)
information_gaps: Requires assured irrigation every 12-15 days for multi-cut harvest.

source_notes.agronomy: ICAR-Indian Grassland and Fodder Research Institute (IGFRI), Jhansi.
source_notes.forage: Provides 4-6 cuttings of crude protein-rich fodder (18-20% CP) for dairy livestock.

name: Sugarcane
information_gaps: Mill tie-up and payment clearance cycles heavily determine farmer profitability beyond agronomic fit.

source_notes.agronomy: Sugarcane Research Institute, Pusa (Dr. Rajendra Prasad Central Agricultural University, Samastipur, Bihar).
source_notes.water_req: ICAR-Indian Institute of Sugarcane Research (IISR), Lucknow.

name: Jute
information_gaps: Requires availability of clean standing retting water bodies post-harvest in July-August.

source_notes.agronomy: ICAR-Central Research Institute for Jute and Allied Fibres (CRIJAF), Barrackpore.
source_notes.regional_fit: Prominent in North-East Bihar (Kishanganj, Purnia, Katihar, Araria).

name: Potato
information_gaps: High price volatility and cold storage access determine economic viability.

source_notes.agronomy: ICAR-Central Potato Research Station (CPRS), Patna & CPRI Shimla.
source_notes.temperature: Optimum tuberization temperature is 18-20°C; sharply inhibited above 25°C.

name: Vegetables (Seasonal: Okra, Cole crops)
information_gaps: Requires proximity (<30 km) or refrigerated transport to local peri-urban mandi.

source_notes.agronomy: ICAR-Indian Institute of Vegetable Research (IIVR), Varanasi.

name: Fox Nut / Gorgon Nut
information_gaps: Field-based cropping system developed by ICAR-RCER (field depth 1-1.5 ft water) allows integration with fish or subsequent rabi wheat.

source_notes.agronomy: National Research Centre for Makhana / ICAR-RCER Research Centre on Makhana, Darbhanga, Bihar.
source_notes.geographical_indication: Mithila Makhana Geographical Indication (GI) Registry of India.
